MOST DISRESPECTFUL and UNPROFESSIONAL experience EVER
Mar 2025 • Couples
I purposely ordered BEFORE a table of ten sat down. Only two others ordered before me and everyone else in the restaurant,(six people),had already eaten. It was explained to me when I ordered that it would take some time as they were busy. Fair enough I thought but realistically, the only people ordering are the two before myself and my wife and the ten who were being seated after I ordered. The couple who ordered literally three minutes before I did got their food 20 minutes later. After at least one hour after ordering, we noticed that the table of ten were eating. My wife inquired as to what was happening and the staff suggested that maybe our order was forgotten. Are you kidding me? I want results not excuses. I noticed that the very friendly gentleman who took my order was also cooking. There was also another five men waiting to be seated. Seriously, if you can’t cope with only 19 customers over a one hour period, then either employ more staff or just turn people away so you don’t get reviews like this.

The other thing we noticed was the substantial amount of deliveries that were being cooked after we ordered. Maybe we should order delivery so we get our food within 30 minutes and then just occupy one of their restaurant tables to eat.

Disgraceful effort. Lost our docket? Switch on people.

Seems to me that due to the ten Indian patrons stepping off a bus, are part of a package deal who’ve already paid. That to me indicates that ONE NIGHT STANDS are more important than potential life time customers like myself. I say this because the restaurant staff NEW that I live here.

We ended up going to the Indian Family Restaurant at 21:20 and were eating by 21:35. Amazing how Lazeez has a score of 5 on google maps and Family Indian has a score of 4.3.

My wife and I decided to give them another go nt ordering delivery a few months later. OMGoodness. That was seriously the worst food regardless the type of cuisine that I’ve ever had. We ditched all of it. Burnt bread. Severely separated oily curry. Rice that smelt off and lamb with literally only one mouthful of meat which was also oily and separated.

I posted on to FB about the restaurant experience and the reply was SWEARING AT MY WIFE and I. Are you KIDDING US???
